summary.text: John Marquardt is a Republican candidate for the South Dakota House of Representatives, District 18, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the June 2 Republican primary.

paragraphs.text: John Marquardt ran in the June 4, 2024 Republican primary for South Dakota House District 18, where incumbents Julie Auch and Mike Stevens defeated him.
